announcement.title: Workbench 2.0.6 is here
announcement.message: Workbench 2.0.6 adds subscription sign-in for AI providers — connect with your ChatGPT (OpenAI / Codex) or xAI (Grok) subscription instead of an API key — plus Load More / Load All in the SOQL Explorer to browse query results past the 2,000-record cap.
